# Reacticx component catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/skills/generate-catalog.ts — do not edit by hand. -->

Registry version 1.0.0 · 163 components · source https://github.com/rit3zh/reacticx

Every entry lists the CLI key — the name `reacticx add` and the MCP
`add_components` tool both take. **Dependencies** are the npm packages the
component's own source imports; **uses** are other registry components that
come along automatically unless you turn dependency following off.

```bash
npx reacticx add <cli-key>
```

## Categories

| Category | Components |
| --- | --- |
| `atoms` | 1 — The smallest building blocks — one element, one job. |
| `base` | 15 — Foundational inputs and surfaces most screens end up using. |
| `blocks` | 19 — Composed sections you drop into a screen whole. |
| `charts` | 5 — Data visualisation, Skia-backed. |
| `micro-interactions` | 10 — Small motion pieces that make a screen feel alive. |
| `molecules` | 45 — A handful of atoms wired together into something useful. |
| `organisms` | 40 — Large, self-contained pieces with their own state and gestures. |
| `pieces` | 10 — Decorative and structural fragments. |
| `primitives` | 9 — Unstyled behaviour you compose your own look on top of. |
| `screens` | 1 — Whole screens, ready to route to. |
| `templates` | 8 — Full flows — several screens' worth of layout in one component. |

## Dependencies you will meet

How often each package is imported across the catalog — install with
`npx expo install <package>` so the versions match your Expo SDK.

| Package | Components using it |
| --- | --- |
| `react-native-reanimated` | 126 |
| `@shopify/react-native-skia` | 45 |
| `react-native-worklets` | 40 |
| `react-native-svg` | 37 |
| `expo-blur` | 30 |
| `react-native-gesture-handler` | 25 |
| `react-native-safe-area-context` | 24 |
| `@expo/vector-icons` | 20 |
| `expo-haptics` | 17 |
| `expo-linear-gradient` | 15 |
| `expo-router` | 10 |
| `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` | 7 |
| `@react-native-masked-view/masked-view` | 7 |
| `expo-symbols` | 6 |
| `@hugeicons/core-free-icons` | 5 |

Two of these catch people out:

- `react-native-worklets` is a **separate install** from
  `react-native-reanimated` (Reanimated 4 moved worklets out).
- `@sbaiahmed1/react-native-blur` is a scoped npm package — not the
  unscoped `react-native-blur`, which is a different library.

> After adding any **native** dependency, rebuild the native target
> (`npx expo run:ios`). Restarting Metro is not enough.
